principles: Keep order-level contribution, new-customer acquisition cost, blended efficiency, lifetime gross profit, and cash needs visible together; no single platform metric answers whether to scale.
Use realized, cohort-based repeat purchases when evaluating lifetime value; the video mostly addresses established brands with historical customer data.
Connect marketing reports back to the P&L and cash conversion cycle before increasing acquisition spend.

limitations: Metric definitions and attribution windows need to match the store's accounting and customer data. A new store cannot validate future LTV from historical cohorts it does not have.
